posts.title: Green juices I like
posts.description: Keeping track of the green juices I like having first thing in the morning. My favorite: 2-3 mini cucumbers 2 carrots (or equivalent baby carrots) 1 apple 1 grapefruit peeled 1 lime peeled tumeric mint leaves can add spinach without changing taste much Another combination: 2 celery 2-3 baby cucumber 1 apple 1 lemon peeled 1 orange peeled For all: Blend in vitamix with 1 cup of water and some ice.
